_template: FIND-106 template_version 1.1.0, docs_verified 2026-09-17 (https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks). WIRE-10: one-shot via `vanta-cli mcp-call` (no pwsh). Merge into .claude/settings.json. DB: replace <DB_PATH>; vanta-cli must be on PATH (install.sh puts it in ~/.vanta/bin). Secrets: session env only. Hook input arrives on stdin as JSON; {{prompt}} splices the verbatim UserPromptSubmit text (mcp-call resolves it, jq not needed).

hooks._policy: memory_recall scope=agent top_k=5 -> additionalContext; empty recall injects NOTHING
memory_recall query=<verbatim user text> scope=agent top_k=5; never paraphrase

hooks.command: echo VantaDB save-state: persist open turns via thread_send and/or scene_write before compaction.
hooks._policy: save-state via thread_send and/or scene_write before compaction

hooks.command: echo VantaDB auto-capture: persist this turn via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns curated via inbox, never auto-promote.
hooks._policy: auto-capture turn via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns curated via inbox, never auto-promote
